crossRefs.note: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, for I am desolate and afflicted.
Answer me, Yahweh, for your loving kindness is good. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, turn to me.
Relent, Yahweh! How long? Have compassion on your servants!
Turn to me, and have mercy on me, as you always do to those who love your name.
Yahweh is my strength and my shield. My heart has trusted in him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart greatly rejoices.…
Yahweh is their strength. He is a stronghold of salvation to his anointed.
Blessed are those whose strength is in you, who have set their hearts on a pilgrimage.
In the day that I called, you answered me. You encouraged me with strength in my soul.
He gives power to the weak. He increases the strength of him who has no might.
They will say of me, ‘There is righteousness and strength only in Yahweh.’ ” Even to him will men come. All those who…
I will strengthen them in Yahweh; and they will walk up and down in his name,” says Yahweh.
that he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, that you may be strengthened with power through his…
Finally, be strong in the Lord, and in the strength of his might.
I can do all things through Christ, who strengthens me.
strengthened with all power, according to the might of his glory, for all endurance and perseverance with joy,
Yahweh, truly I am your servant. I am your servant, the son of your servant girl. You have freed me from my chains.
I am yours. Save me, for I have sought your precepts.
Mary said, “Behold, the servant of the Lord; let it be done to me according to your word.” The angel departed from her.

translations.web: Turn to me, and have mercy on me! Give your strength to your servant. Save the son of your servant.
translations.bsb: Turn to me and have mercy; grant Your strength to Your servant; save the son of Your maidservant.
translations.kjv: O turn unto me, and have mercy upon me; give thy strength unto thy servant, and save the son of thine handmaid.
translations.asv: Oh turn unto me, and have mercy upon me; Give thy strength unto thy servant, And save the son of thy handmaid.
